# Mesfin Genie

::: {.standfirst}
Senior Lecturer in Health Economics, University of Newcastle
:::

I measure what people are willing to give up. Patients trade waiting time against
cost, side effects against survival. Governments make the same trades on their
behalf and rarely say so out loud.

My work puts numbers on those trades, then asks the harder question: whether the
numbers mean anything when the person answering has read only half the
information. That is why I run eye trackers alongside surveys.

[Papers](/publications/) · [Tools](/tools/) · [CV](/cv/) ·
[mesfin.genie@newcastle.edu.au](mailto:mesfin.genie@newcastle.edu.au)

:::

## Try it: three questions, and I will price your patience

```{=html}
<div class="ct" id="choice-task">
  <div class="ct-frame">
    <div id="ct-ask">
      <p class="ct-q">Question <span id="ct-n">1</span> of 3</p>
      <p class="ct-stem">Two clinics can see you. They are alike except for these two things. Which do you book?</p>
      <div class="ct-grid">
        <div class="ct-cell ct-head"><span class="visually-hidden">Attribute</span></div>
        <div class="ct-cell ct-head">Clinic A</div>
        <div class="ct-cell ct-head">Clinic B</div>
        <div class="ct-cell ct-attr">Wait</div>
        <div class="ct-cell ct-val">2 weeks</div>
        <div class="ct-cell ct-val">6 weeks</div>
        <div class="ct-cell ct-attr">Cost to you</div>
        <div class="ct-cell ct-val" id="ct-bid">$80</div>
        <div class="ct-cell ct-val">No cost</div>
      </div>
      <div class="ct-actions">
        <span></span>
        <button type="button" class="ct-pick" data-pick="A">Clinic A</button>
        <button type="button" class="ct-pick" data-pick="B">Clinic B</button>
      </div>
      <div class="ct-dots" aria-hidden="true">
        <span class="ct-dot"></span><span class="ct-dot"></span><span class="ct-dot"></span>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div id="ct-out" class="ct-result" tabindex="-1" aria-live="polite">
      <p class="ct-q">What your answers imply</p>
      <p class="ct-answer" id="ct-answer"></p>
      <div class="ct-figure">
        <div class="ct-bar"><div class="ct-band" id="ct-band"></div></div>
        <div class="ct-scale"><span>$0</span><span>$150</span><span>$300+</span></div>
      </div>
      <details class="au" style="margin-top:0.9rem">
        <summary>How this works <span class="au-more">read more</span></summary>
        <span class="au-full">Each question moved the price up or down depending on your last answer, so three choices bracket the point where you switch. A real discrete choice experiment does this across hundreds of people and six or seven attributes at once, and estimates the switching point rather than bracketing it.</span>
      </details>
      <button type="button" class="ct-restart" id="ct-restart">Start again</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```
